lessons_control.note: pre_lessons is each hunter's own sum before it read researcher_us/LESSONS.md. edge_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, which is the only thing that can tell the guidance file apart from a habit.

language_control.note: RETIRED 2026-09-22: the European and Canadian hunters now run one bilingual pass and emit no freeze, so this is 0/0 on every run sealed after that date. On earlier runs pre_local is each hunter's own sum after the ENGLISH pass and before the local pass; eu_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, per market, and does not pool the UK (where the second pass varied source locality) with Germany and France (where it varied language).

note: Ranked on impact_sum: the hunters' signed per-finding sizes, added up, in points of spot. No call and no threshold -- cut wherever you like afterwards, which is what keeps the ranking question answerable at every k. `conviction` (abs of the key) is where the direction skill lives: over all events the sign is a coin flip, above the median conviction it is 74%. conviction_floor is a floor on emphasis in the note, never a filter on this file. Everything under `diagnostics` was measured as neutral or subtractive and decides nothing -- see researcher_us/EDGE_ANALYSIS.md.

findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No documented VKTX reaction to retatrutide headlines in this file.

findings.finding: Viking corrected its 2026-10-06 release: the oral maintenance study (Part 2, about 195 adults, readout in 2027) tests daily oral dosing, not weekly oral doses, after 21 weeks of weekly subcutaneous induction. The 'weekly oral' option implied by the original wording does not exist in the trial.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None on record. The stock fell about 17% in the month to mid-October, which spans this correction.

findings.finding: The reported-quarter line does not move this name. Q2 2026 beat (-$1.10 vs -$1.21 consensus, the first beat in six reports) and the stock still fell (-0.96% close to close in the baseline, -4.14% the next day per 24/7 Wall St). Q3 R&D should rise from $115.8m as both VANQUISH trials are fully enrolled and SUNRISE starts, so EPS is more likely to land a little below the disputed -$1.00 to -$1.06 bar than above it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Last seven prints: -0.96, -0.48, +6.80, +7.96, +0.30, -0.50, -6.09; median absolute 0.96%. A beat was sold in Q2 2026.

outside_window.finding: VANQUISH-1/2 78-week readouts: both trials are fully enrolled, so readout is plausibly 2027. No date is given in the 7/29 or 10/14 releases. A timing statement on the call would land in the window; the data itself lands well outside it.
Oral maintenance study Part 2 (about 195 adults) results expected in 2027.

lessons_applied: Lessons 5 and 7: positioning alone is not a catalyst, and here the drawdown has a documented cause (the discounted $35 offering). The crowded-short/round-trip finding went from +1.0 to +0.6; it is kept, not dropped, because the core requires filing it.

Lesson 4: I asked what the September financing buys. It funds VANQUISH-1/2 and SUNRISE, corroborated by the 10/14 trial initiation, so the financing finding stays positive and small at +0.3, unchanged.
Lessons 1 and 6: the EPS bar is disputed (-1.00 vs -1.06) and the Q2 beat was sold, so the reported-quarter finding stays at 0 and print_vs_bar is low-confidence. Unchanged.

findings.finding: The company reaffirmed FY2026 revenue of $10-15m and guided 2027 revenue to double on 2026-10-07, after Q3 had closed: the CFO said 'we are confident in our ability to meet the full year guidance in the range of $10 million-$15 million', and management said it was 'shipping sensors until the last day of the quarter to maximize revenue'. A guide cut at this print is therefore less likely than the name's history of missed street numbers implies (Q2 revenue $1.47m against a $3.38m estimate).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The reaffirmation itself was sold: a third-party price table shows the stock -13.8% on 4.6m shares on 2026-10-08, the session after the 16:05 ET 8-K. In the baseline, prints that carried guidance (03-04 -29.5%, 05-13 -21.1%) were sold hard; the 08-06 print that reiterated the guide and raised gross margin rose 4.0%.

findings.finding: The cash runway does not reach year-end without more equity. Cash was $27.2m on 2026-06-30. The $17.0m gross unit offering of 6.8m shares plus 6.8m warrants at $2.50 netted $15.6m on 2026-08-17. Against that sit about $60m of FY2026 burn guidance, of which $35.6m of operating cash was used in H1, and convertible-note redemptions scheduled at $19.8m for the rest of 2026 ($3.0m a month plus a 10% premium). The 10-Q carries going-concern language and a minimum-cash covenant of the lesser of $17.5m or 110% of the note balance. The offering's 45-day lock-up on new issuance and note repayments ended about 2026-10-01, leaving $41.2m of ATM availability. On my walk, Q3-end cash is roughly $25-30m and Q4 needs ATM sales or note conversions into stock, which the Q3 10-Q cover share count will show.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026-08-14/17 offering at $2.50 coincided with a reported -40.7% session (search snippet); the stock is now $1.23, below the $2.50 offer and warrant strike. Every print in the baseline after a dilution-heavy quarter was down (03-04 -29.5%, 05-13 -21.1%).

findings.finding: Q3 revenue is at risk of landing below whatever street number exists, because the company's own guide is back-loaded. H1 revenue was $2.4m, and the guide needs $7.6-12.6m in H2. On the Q2 call the CEO said MOVIA S has 'not a large revenue portion for 2026' (launched in late October, after Q3) and that IRIS supply was 'more of a timing issue... Q3 or Q4 of this year or Q1 or Q2 of next year'. Q2 revenue missed the $3.38m estimate by 56%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 revenue missed by 56% and the stock rose 4.0% over the print window (08-06), because the guide and the gross-margin raise carried it. Earlier revenue disappointments (03-04, 05-13) were sold 21-30%.

findings.finding: Management pre-announced balance-sheet actions to be detailed 'in the next few weeks as we come up to our Q3 earnings call': a second phase of operating-expense cuts, a review of 'our debt structure and lease obligations', and 'non-core assets... that we could monetize'. A concrete asset sale, note restructuring or opex number at the print would be the first non-dilutive liquidity source on a going-concern name.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print announced an asset sale or debt restructuring. The 05-13 print, which announced a 15% workforce cut and a burn reduction from $65-70m to $60m, still fell 21.1%.

findings.finding: The short is crowded into the print at about 6.2m shares short (2026-09-30 FINRA settlement, 4.3 days to cover), roughly 20% of the 30.15m shares outstanding, while a single individual (Johannes Gnauck / JG Global LLC) disclosed a 7.9% long stake (2.38m shares) on a 13G with event date 2026-09-16. That is a squeeze mechanism on any non-negative surprise in a $37m stock.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The baseline shows only one up print in seven (+4.0% on 08-06); no squeeze on a print is visible in the history.

outside_window.finding: Listing risk returns. Spot is $1.23, 23% above the $1 Nasdaq bid floor that MVIS regained compliance with on 2026-08-26, after a 1-for-15 reverse split effective 2026-08-01. Another deficiency needs 30 consecutive sessions below $1, which cannot occur inside this window.

Monthly convertible-note partial redemptions ($3.0m plus a 10% premium, about $19.8m scheduled for the rest of 2026, maturity March 2028) keep producing conversion share supply or cash drain into Q4 and beyond.

lessons_applied: Rule 6 (bar unsourced: no Q3 consensus, and the Q2 estimates disagreed): capped every finding small; the guidance finding sits inside what the company already guided, so it went from +1.0 to +0.5.
Rule 7 (crowded short at about 20% of shares, 4.3 days to cover): the financing negative shrank from -1.5 to -1.0.
Rule 4 (financing is a question): answered. The money funds losses and note redemptions with a going-concern flag and no corroborated ramp, so the sign stays negative.
Rule 5 (inference from phasing comments rather than a counted number): Q3 revenue risk went from -1.0 to -0.75.
Rule 1 (this name sells its prints, 6 of 7 down): the balance-sheet-action and positioning positives each went from +1.0 to +0.75; p_up moved from 45 to 46 net of the squeeze argument.
Rule 6 window: the listing-risk and note-redemption items stayed in outside_window.
